subject.title: fix(scripts): warn when postinstall detects running gateway with stale module imports

question: Should OpenClaw accept a package postinstall loopback probe plus OPENCLAW_DISABLE_POSTINSTALL_RESTART_WARNING as an advisory mitigation for stale gateway imports?
rationale: The code path is coherent, but install-time network probing, a new environment surface, and overlap with the update-CLI warning PR are product and operator-experience choices rather than defects automation can settle.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Require a redacted real postinstall proof run, then merge this as warning-only mitigation while keeping the stale-gateway issue open.

options.title: Require Full Gateway Scenario
options.body: Ask for a package update or rollback run with an already-running gateway before accepting the install-time probe.

options.title: Use One Recovery Layer
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want update CLI output or runtime stale-import handling to be the only warning and recovery boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted real postinstall proof run, then merge this as warning-only mitigation while keeping the stale-gateway issue open.
